vayyêredhu 'êlâyv vayyithpallêl 'eliyshâ` 'el-Adonay vayyo'marhakh-nâ' 'eth-haggoy-hazzeh bassanvêriym vayyakkêmbassanvêriym kidhbhar 'eliyshâ`
vayyo'mer 'alêhem 'eliyshâ` lo'zeh hadderekh velo' zoh hâ`iyr lekhu 'acharay ve'oliykhâh 'ethkhem'el-hâ'iysh 'asher tebhaqqêshun vayyolekh 'othâm shomeronâh
vayhiykebho'âm shomeron vayyo'mer 'eliyshâ` Adonay peqach'eth-`êynêy-'êlleh veyir'u vayyiphqach Adonay 'eth-`êynêyhemvayyir'u vehinnêh bethokh shomeron
vayyo'mer melekh-yisrâ'êl'el-'eliyshâ` kir'otho 'othâm ha'akkeh 'akkeh 'âbhiy
vayyo'merlo' thakkeh ha'asher shâbhiythâ becharbekha ubheqashtekha 'attâh makkehsiym lechem vâmayim liphnêyhem veyo'khlu veyishtu veyêlekhu'el-'adhonêyhem
vayyikhreh lâhem kêrâh ghedholâh vayyo'khluvayyishtu vayshallechêm vayyêlekhu 'el-'adhonêyhem velo'-yâsephu `odhgedhudhêy 'arâm lâbho' be'erets yisrâ'êl ph
vayhiy 'acharêy-khênvayyiqbots ben-hadhadh melekh-'arâm 'eth-kâl-machanêhu vayya`alvayyâtsar `al-shomeron
vayhiy râ`âbh gâdhol beshomeron vehinnêhtsâriym `âleyhâ `adh heyoth ro'sh-chamor bishmoniym keseph verobha`haqqabh charêyyoniym [dibhyoniym] bachamishâh-khâseph
vayhiymelekh yisrâ'êl `obhêr `al-hachomâh ve'ishâh tsâ`aqâh 'êlâyv lê'morhoshiy`âh 'adhoniy hammelekh
vayyo'mer 'al-yoshi`êkh Adonaymê'ayin 'oshiy`êkh hamin-haggoren 'o min-hayyâqebh
vayyo'mer-lâh hammelekh mah-lâkh vatto'mer hâ'ishâh hazzo'th'âmerâh 'êlay teniy 'eth-benêkh veno'khlennu hayyom ve'eth-beniyno'khal mâchâr
vannebhashêl 'eth-beniy vanno'khlêhu vâ'omar 'êleyhâ.bayyom hâ'achêr teniy 'eth-benêkh veno'khlennu vattachbi' 'eth-benâh
vayhiy khishmoa` hammelekh 'eth-dibhrêy hâ'ishâh vayyiqra` 'eth-beghâdhâyv vehu' `obhêr `al-hachomâh vayyar' hâ`âm vehinnêh hasaq`al-besâro mibbâyith
vayyo'mer koh-ya`aseh-liy 'elohiym vekhohyosiph 'im-ya`amodh ro'sh 'eliyshâ` ben-shâphâth `âlâyv hayyom

ve'eliyshâ` yoshêbh bebhêytho vehazzeqêniym yoshebhiym 'itto vayyishlach'iysh millephânâyv betherem yâbho' hammal'âkh 'êlâyv vehu' 'âmar'el-hazzeqêniym harre'iythem kiy-shâlach ben-hamratsêach hazzehlehâsiyr 'eth-ro'shiy re'u kebho' hammal'âkh sighru haddeleth ulechatstem'otho baddeleth halo' qol raghlêy 'adhonâyv 'acharâyv
`odhennumedhabbêr `immâm vehinnêh hammal'âkh yorêdh 'êlâyv vayyo'merhinnêh-zo'th hârâ`âh mê'êth Adonay mâh-'ochiyl layhvh `odh s
vayyo'mer 'eliyshâ` shim`u debhar-Adonay koh 'âmarAdonay kâ`êth mâchâr se'âh-soleth besheqel vesâ'thayim se`oriymbesheqel besha`ar shomeron

vayya`an hashâliysh 'asher-lammelekh nish`ân`al-yâdho 'eth-'iysh hâ'elohiym vayyo'mar hinnêh Adonay `oseh'arubboth bashâmayim hayihyeh haddâbhâr hazzeh vayyo'merhinnekhâh ro'eh be`êyneykha umishâm lo' tho'khêl s
ve'arbâ`âh'anâshiym hâyu metsorâ`iym pethach hashâ`ar vayyo'mru 'iysh 'el-rê`êhu mâh 'anachnu yoshebhiym poh `adh-mâthenu
'im-'âmarnunâbho' hâ`iyr vehârâ`âbh bâ`iyr vâmathnu shâm ve'im-yâshabhnu phohvâmâthenu ve`attâh lekhu venippelâh 'el-machanêh 'arâm 'im-yechayyunu nichyeh ve'im-yemiythunu vâmâthenu
vayyâqumubhannesheph lâbho' 'el-machanêh 'arâm vayyâbho'u `adh-qetsêh machanêh'arâm vehinnêh 'êyn-shâm 'iysh

va'dhonây hishmiya` 'eth-machanêh'arâm qol rekhebh qol sus qol chayil gâdhol vayyo'mru 'iysh 'el-'âchiyvhinnêh sâkhar-`âlêynu melekh yisrâ'êl 'eth-malkhêy hachittiym ve'eth-malkhêy mitsrayim lâbho' `âlêynu
vayyâqumu vayyânusu bhanneshephvayya`azbhu 'eth-'oholêyhem ve'eth-susêyhem ve'eth-chamorêyhemhammachaneh ka'asher-hiy' vayyânusu 'el-naphshâm

vayyâbho'uhamtsorâ`iym hâ'êlleh `adh-qetsêh hammachaneh vayyâbho'u 'el-'ohel.'echâdh vayyo'khlu vayyishtu vayyis'u mishâm keseph vezâhâbhubheghâdhiym vayyêlekhu vayyathminu vayyâshubhu vayyâbho'u 'el-'ohel'achêr vayyis'u mishâm vayyêlekhu vayyathminu

vayyo'mru 'iysh'el-rê`êhu lo'-khên 'anachnu `osiym hayyom hazzeh yom-besorâhhu' va'anachnu machshiym vechikkiynu `adh-'or habboqer umetsâ'ânu`âvon ve`attâh lekhu venâbho'âh venaggiydhâh bêyth hammelekh
vayyâbho'u vayyiqre'u 'el-sho`êr hâ`iyr vayyaggiydhu lâhem lê'morbâ'nu 'el-machanêh 'arâm vehinnêh 'êyn-shâm 'iysh veqol 'âdhâmkiy 'im-hassus 'âsur vehachamor 'âsur ve'ohâliym ka'asher-hêmmâh
vayyiqrâ' hasho`ariym vayyaggiydhu bêyth hammelekh peniymâh

vayyâqâm hammelekh laylâh vayyo'mer 'el-`abhâdhâyv'aggiydhâh-nâ' lâkhem 'êth 'asher-`âsu lânu 'arâm yâdh`u kiy-re`êbhiym'anachnu vayyêtse'u min-hammachaneh lehêchâbhêh bhehasâdheh[bha][sâdheh] lê'mor kiy-yêtse'u min-hâ`iyr venithpesêm chayyiymve'el-hâ`iyr nâbho'

vayya`an 'echâdh mê`abhâdhâyv vayyo'merveyiqchu-nâ' chamishâh min-hassusiym hannish'âriym 'asher nish'aru-bhâh hinnâm kekhol-hehâmon [hamon] yisrâ'êl 'asher nish'aru-bhâhhinnâm kekhol-hamon yisrâ'êl 'asher-tâmmu venishlechâh venir'eh
vayyiqchu shenêy rekhebh susiym vayyishlach hammelekh 'acharêymachanêh-'arâm lê'mor lekhu ure'u
vayyêlekhu 'acharêyhem `adh-hayyardên vehinnêh khol-hadderekh melê'âh bheghâdhiym vekhêliym'asher-hishliykhu 'arâm behêchâphzâm [b][châphzâm] vayyâshubhuhammal'âkhiym vayyaggidhu lammelekh
vayyêtsê' hâ`âmvayyâbhozzu 'êth machanêh 'arâm vayhiy se'âh-soleth besheqelvesâ'thayim se`oriym besheqel kidhbhar Adonay
vehammelekhhiphqiydh 'eth-hashâliysh 'asher-nish`ân `al-yâdho `al-hasha`arvayyirmesuhu hâ`âm basha`ar vayyâmoth ka'asher dibber 'iyshhâ'elohiym 'asher dibber beredheth hammelekh 'êlâyv
vayhiykedhabbêr 'iysh hâ'elohiym 'el-hammelekh lê'mor sâ'thayim se`oriymbesheqel use'âh-soleth besheqel yihyeh kâ`êth mâchâr besha`ar shomeron
vayya`an hashâliysh 'eth-'iysh hâ'elohiym vayyo'mar vehinnêhAdonay `oseh 'arubboth bashâmayim hayihyeh kaddâbhâr hazzeh.vayyo'mer hinnekha ro'eh be`êyneykha umishâm lo' tho'khêl
vayhiy-lo kên vayyirmesu 'otho hâ`âm basha`ar vayyâmoth s
ve'eliyshâ` dibber 'el-hâ'ishâh 'asher-hecheyâh 'eth-benâhlê'mor qumiy ulekhiy 'attiy ['at] ubhêythêkh veghuriy ba'asher tâghuriykiy-qârâ' Adonay lârâ`âbh vegham-bâ' 'el-hâ'ârets shebha` shâniym
vattâqâm hâ'ishâh vatta`as kidhbhar 'iysh hâ'elohiym vattêlekh hiy'ubhêythâh vattâghâr be'erets-pelishtiym shebha` shâniym
vayhiy miqtsêhshebha` shâniym vattâshâbh hâ'ishâh mê'erets pelishtiym vattêtsê' lits`oq'el-hammelekh 'el-bêythâh ve'el-sâdhâh
vehammelekh medhabbêr 'el-gêchaziy na`ar 'iysh-hâ'elohiym lê'mor sapperâh-nâ' liy 'êth kol-haggedholoth 'asher-`âsâh 'eliyshâ`

vayhiy hu' mesappêr lammelekh'êth 'asher-hecheyâh 'eth-hammêth vehinnêh hâ'ishâh 'asher-hecheyâh'eth-benâh tso`eqeth 'el-hammelekh `al-bêythâh ve`al-sâdhâh vayyo'mergêchaziy 'adhoniy hammelekh zo'th hâ'ishâh vezeh-benâh 'asher-hecheyâh'eliyshâ`
vayyish'al hammelekh lâ'ishâh vattesapper-lo vayyitten-lâhhammelekh sâriys 'echâdh lê'mor hâshêybh 'eth-kâl-'asher-lâh ve'êth kol-tebhu'oth hasâdheh miyyom `âzbhâh 'eth-hâ'ârets ve`adh-`âttâh ph
vayyâbho' 'eliyshâ` dammeseq ubhen-hadhadh melekh-'arâm cholehvayyuggadh-lo lê'mor bâ' 'iysh hâ'elohiym `adh-hênnâh
vayyo'merhammelekh 'el-chazâh'êl qach beyâdhkha minchâh velêkh liqra'th 'iyshhâ'elohiym vedhârashtâ 'eth-Adonay mê'otho lê'mor ha'echyehmêcholiy zeh

vayyêlekh chazâ'êl liqrâ'tho vayyiqqach minchâh bheyâdhovekhol-thubh dammeseq masâ' 'arbâ`iym gâmâl vayyâbho'vayya`amodh lephânâyv vayyo'mer binkha bhen-hadhadh melekh-'arâmshelâchaniy 'êleykha lê'mor ha'echyeh mêcholiy zeh
vayyo'mer'êlâyv 'eliyshâ` lêkh 'emâr-lo' [lo] châyoh thichyeh vehir'aniyAdonay kiy-moth yâmuth
vayya`amêdh 'eth-pânâyv vayyâsem`adh-bosh vayyêbhekh 'iysh hâ'elohiym

vayyo'mer chazâ'êl maddua`'adhoniy bhokheh vayyo'mer kiy-yâdha`tiy 'êth 'asher-ta`aseh libhnêyyisrâ'êl râ`âh mibhtserêyhem teshallach bâ'êsh ubhachurêyhem bacherebhtaharogh ve`olelêyhem terathêsh vehârothêyhem tebhaqqêa`
vayyo'mer.chazâh'êl kiy mâh `abhdekha hakkelebh kiy ya`aseh haddâbhâr haggâdholhazzeh vayyo'mer 'eliyshâ` hir'aniy Adonay 'othekha melekh`al-'arâm
vayyêlekh mê'êth 'eliyshâ` vayyâbho' 'el-'adhonâyvvayyo'mer lomâh-'âmar lekha 'eliyshâ` vayyo'mer 'âmar liy châyohthichyeh
vayhiy mimmochorâth vayyiqqach hammakhbêr vayyithbolbammayim vayyiphros `al-pânâyv vayyâmoth vayyimlokh chazâh'êltachtâyv ph
ubhishnath châmêsh leyorâm ben-'ach'âbh melekh yisrâ'êlviyhoshâphâth melekh yehudhâh mâlakh yehorâm ben-yehoshâphâth melekhyehudhâh
ben-sheloshiym ushetayim shânâh hâyâh bhemolkho ushemonehshânâh [shâniym] mâlakh biyrushâlâim
vayyêlekh bedherekh malkhêyyisrâ'êl ka'asher `âsu bêyth 'ach'âbh kiy bath-'ach'âbh hâythâh-lo le'ishâhvayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonay
velo'-'âbhâh Adonaylehashchiyth 'eth-yehudhâh lema`an dâvidh `abhdo ka'asher 'âmar-lo lâthêthlo niyr lebhânâyv kol-hayyâmiym
beyâmâyv pâsha` 'edhommittachath yadh-yehudhâh vayyamlikhu `alêyhem melekh
vayya`abhoryorâm tsâ`iyrâh vekhol-hârekhebh `immo vayhiy-hu' qâm laylâhvayyakkeh 'eth-'edhom hassobhêybh 'êlâyv ve'êth sârêy hârekhebhvayyânâs hâ`âm le'ohâlâyv
vayyiphsha` 'edhom mittachath yadh-yehudhâh `adh hayyom hazzeh 'âz tiphsha` libhnâh bâ`êth hahiy'
veyether dibhrêy yorâm vekhol-'asher `âsâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yehudhâh
vayyishkabh yorâm`im-'abhothâyv vayyiqqâbhêr `im-'abhothâyv be`iyr dâvidh vayyimlokh'achazyâhu bheno tachtâyv ph
bishnath shetêym-`esrêh shânâh leyorâmben-'ach'âbh melekh yisrâ'êl mâlakh 'achazyâhu bhen-yehorâm melekhyehudhâh
ben-`esriym ushetayim shânâh 'achazyâhu bhemolkhoveshânâh 'achath mâlakh biyrushâlâim veshêm 'immo `athalyâhubath-`âmriy melekh yisrâ'êl
vayyêlekh bedherekh bêyth 'ach'âbhvayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonay kebhêyth 'ach'âbh kiy chathanbêyth-'ach'âbh hu'
vayyêlekh 'eth-yorâm ben-'ach'âbh lammilchâmâh`im-chazâh'êl melekh-'arâm berâmoth gil`âdh vayyakku 'arammiym'eth-yorâm

vayyâshâbh yorâm hammelekh lehithrappê' bheyizre`e'lmin-hammakkiym 'asher yakkuhu 'arammiym bârâmâh.behillâchamo 'eth-chazâh'êl melekh 'arâm va'achazyâhu bhen-yehorâmmelekh yehudhâh yâradh lir'oth 'eth-yorâm ben-'ach'âbh beyizre`e'l kiy-choleh hu' ph
ve'eliyshâ` hannâbhiy' qârâ' le'achadh mibbenêyhannebhiy'iym vayyo'mer lo chaghor mothneykha veqach pakh hashemenhazzeh beyâdhekha velêkh râmothggil`âdh
ubhâ'thâ shâmmâh ure'êh-shâmyêhu' bhen-yehoshâphâth ben-nimshiy ubhâ'thâ vahaqêmotho mittokh 'echâyvvehêbhêy'thâ 'otho chedher bechâdher
velâqachtâ phakh-hashemen veyâtsaqtâ`al-ro'sho ve'âmartâ koh-'âmar Adonay meshachtiykha lemelekh 'el-yisrâ'êl uphâthachtâ haddeleth venastâh velo' thechakkeh
vayyêlekhhanna`ar hanna`ar hannâbhiy' râmothggil`âdh
vayyâbho' vehinnêhsârêy hachayil yoshebhiym vayyo'mer dâbhâr liy 'êleykha hasârvayyo'mer yêhu' 'el-miy mikkullânu vayyo'mer 'êleykha hasâr
vayyâqâm vayyâbho' habbaythâh vayyitsoq hashemen 'el-ro'shovayyo'mer lo koh-'âmar Adonay 'elohêy yisrâ'êl meshachtiykhalemelekh 'el-`am Adonay 'el-yisrâ'êl
vehikkiythâh 'eth-bêyth'ach'âbh 'adhoneykha veniqqamtiy demêy `abhâdhay hannebhiy'iymudhemêy kol-`abhdhêy Adonay miyyadh 'iyzâbhel
ve'âbhadh kol-bêyth'ach'âbh vehikhrattiy le'ach'âbh mashtiyn beqiyr ve`âtsur ve`âzubh beyisrâ'êl
venâthattiy 'eth-bêyth 'ach'âbh kebhêyth yârâbh`âm ben-nebhâth ukhebhêythba`shâ' bhen-'achiyyâh
ve'eth-'iyzebhel yo'khlu hakkelâbhiym bechêleqyizre`e'l ve'êyn qobhêr vayyiphtach haddeleth vayyânos
veyêhu'yâtsâ' 'el-`abhdhêy 'adhonâyv vayyo'mer lo hashâlom maddua` bâ'-hamshuggâ` hazzeh 'êleykha vayyo'mer 'alêyhem 'attem yedha`tem'eth-hâ'iysh ve'eth-siycho
vayyo'mru sheqer haggedh-nâ' lânuvayyo'mer kâzo'th vekhâzo'th 'âmar 'êlay lê'mor koh 'âmarAdonay meshachtiykha lemelekh 'el-yisrâ'êl
vaymaharuvayyiqchu 'iysh bighdho vayyâsiymu thachtâyv 'el-gerem hamma`alothvayyithqe`u bashophâr vayyo'mru mâlakh yêhu'
vayyithqashêr yêhu'ben-yehoshâphâth ben-nimshiy 'el-yorâm veyorâm hâyâh shomêrberâmoth gil`âdh hu' vekhol-yisrâ'êl mippenêy chazâ'êl melekh-'arâm.

vayyâshâbh yehorâm hammelekh lehithrappê' bhiyzere`e'l min-hammakkiym 'asher yakkuhu 'arammiym behillâchamo 'eth-chazâ'êlmelekh 'arâm vayyo'mer yêhu' 'im-yêsh naphshekhem 'al-yêtsê' phâliythmin-hâ`iyr lâlekheth laggiydh [l][haggiydh] beyizre`e'l
vayyirkabhyêhu' vayyêlekh yizre`e'lâh kiy yorâm shokhêbh shâmmâh va'achazyâhmelekh yehudhâh yâradh lir'oth 'eth-yorâm
vehatsopheh `omêdh `al-hammighdâl beyizre`e'l vayyar' 'eth-shiph`ath yêhu' bebho'o vayyo'mershiph`ath 'aniy ro'eh vayyo'mer yehorâm qach rakkâbh ushelach liqrâ'thâmveyo'mar hashâlom
vayyêlekh rokhêbh hassus liqrâ'tho vayyo'merkoh-'âmar hammelekh hashâlom vayyo'mer yêhu' mah-lekhauleshâlom sobh 'el-'acharây vayyaggêdh hatsopheh lê'mor bâ'-hammal'âkh `adh-hêm velo'-shâbh
vayyishlach rokhêbh sus shêniyvayyâbho' 'alêhem vayyo'mer koh-'âmar hammelekh shâlomvayyo'mer yêhu' mah-lekha uleshâlom sobh 'el-'acharây
vayaggêdhhatsopheh lê'mor bâ' `adh-'alêyhem velo'-shâbh vehamminhâghkeminhagh yêhu' bhen-nimshiy kiy bheshiggâ`on yinhâgh
vayyo'meryehorâm 'esor vayye'sor rikhbo vayyêtsê' yehorâm melekh-yisrâ'êlva'achazyâhu melekh-yehudhâh 'iysh berikhbo vayyêtse'u liqra'th yêhu'vayyimtsâ'uhu bechelqath nâbhoth hayyizre`ê'liy
vayhiy kir'othyehorâm 'eth-yêhu' vayyo'mer hashâlom yêhu' vayyo'mer mâhhashâlom `adh-zenunêy 'iyzebhel 'immekha ukheshâpheyhâ hârabbiym
vayyahaphokh yehorâm yâdhâyv vayyânos vayyo'mer 'el-'achazyâhumirmâh 'achazyâh
veyêhu' millê' yâdho bhaqqesheth vayyakh 'eth-yehorâm bêyn zero`âyv vayyêtsê' hachêtsiy millibbo vayyikhra`berikhbo

vayyo'mer 'el-bidhqar sheloshâh [shâlisho] sâ' hashlikhêhubechelqath sedhêh nâbhoth hayyizre`ê'liy kiy-zekhor 'aniy vâ'attâh 'êthrokhebhiym tsemâdhiym 'acharêy 'ach'âbh 'âbhiyv vayhvh nâsâ' `âlâyv'eth-hammasâ' hazzeh
'im-lo' 'eth-demêy nâbhoth ve'eth-demêybhânâyv râ'iythiy 'emesh ne'um-Adonay veshillamtiy lekha bachelqâhhazzo'th ne'um-Adonay ve`attâh sâ' hashlikhêhu bachelqâh kidhbharAdonay

va'achazyâh melekh-yehudhâh râ'âh vayyânâs derekhbêyth haggân vayyirdoph 'acharâyv yêhu' vayyo'mer gam-'otho.hakkuhu 'el-hammerkâbhâh bema`alêh-ghur 'asher 'eth-yibhle`âmvayyânâs meghiddo vayyâmâth shâm
vayyarkibhu 'otho `abhâdhâyvyerushâlâmâh vayyiqberu 'otho bhiqbhurâtho `im-'abhothâyv be`iyr dâvidhph
ubhishnath 'achath `esrêh shânâh leyorâm ben-'ach'âbh mâlakh 'achazyâh`al-yehudhâh
vayyâbho' yêhu' yizre`e'lâh ve'iyzebhel shâm`âhvattâsem bappukh `êyneyhâ vattêythebh 'eth-ro'shâh vattashqêph be`adhhachallon
veyêhu' bâ' bhashâ`ar vatto'mer hashâlom zimriy horêgh'adhonâyv
vayyisâ' phânâyv 'el-hachallon vayyo'mer miy 'ittiymiy vayyashqiyphu 'êlâyv shenayim sheloshâh sâriysiym
vayyo'mershimthuhu [shimthuhâ] vayyishmethuhâ vayyiz middâmâh 'el-haqqiyrve'el-hassusiym vayyirmesennâh

veyether dibhrêy yeho'âsh'asher `âsâh ughebhurâtho va'asher nilcham `im 'amatsyâhu melekh-yehudhâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêyyisrâ'êl
vayyishkabh yeho'âsh `im-'abhothâyv vayyiqqâbhêr beshomeron`im malkhêy yisrâ'êl vayyimlokh yârâbh`âm beno tachtâyv ph

veyether dibhrêy.'amatsyâhu halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiymlemalkhêy yehudhâh
vayyiqsheru `âlâyv qesher biyrushâlaim vayyânâslâkhiyshâh vayyishlechu 'acharâyv lâkhiyshâh vaymithuhu shâm
vayyis'u'otho `al-hassusiym vayyiqqâbhêr biyrushâlaim `im-'abhothâyv be`iyrdâvidh
vayyiqchu kol-`am yehudhâh 'eth-`azaryâh vehu' ben-shêsh`esrêh shânâh vayyamlikhu 'otho tachath 'âbhiyv 'amatsyâhu
hu'bânâh 'eth-'êylath vayshibhehâ liyhudhâh 'acharêy shekhabh-hammelekh`im-'abhothâyv ph
bishnath chamêsh-`esrêh shânâh la'amatsyâhu bhen-yo'âsh melekh yehudhâh mâlakh yârâbh`âm ben-yo'âsh melekh-yisrâ'êlbeshomeron 'arbâ`iym ve'achath shânâh
vayya`as hâra` be`êynêyAdonay lo' sâr mikkol-chatho'vth yârâbh`âm ben-nebhâth 'asherhechethiy' 'eth-yisrâ'êl
hu' hêshiybh 'eth-gebhul yisrâ'êl millebho' chamâth`adh-yâm hâ`arâbhâh kidhbhar Adonay 'elohêy yisrâ'êl 'asher dibberbeyadh-`abhdo yonâh bhen-'amittay hannâbhiy' 'asher miggathhachêpher
kiy-râ'âh Adonay 'eth-`oniy yisrâ'êl moreh me'odh ve'ephes`âtsur ve'ephes `âzubh ve'êyn `ozêr leyisrâ'êl
velo'-dhibberAdonay limchoth 'eth-shêm yisrâ'êl mittachath hashâmâyimvayyoshiy`êm beyadh yârâbh`âm ben-yo'âsh

veyether dibhrêyyârâbh`âm vekhol-'asher `âsâh ughebhurâtho 'asher-nilchâm va'asher hêshiybh'eth-dammeseq ve'eth-chamâth liyhudhâh beyisrâ'êl halo'-hêm kethubhiym`al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yisrâ'êl
vayyishkabhyârâbh`âm `im-'abhothâyv `im malkhêy yisrâ'êl vayyimlokh zekharyâhbheno tachtâyv ph
bishnath `esriym vâshebha` shânâh leyârâbhe`âm melekhyisrâ'êl mâlakh `azaryâh bhen-'amatsyâh melekh yehudhâh
ben-shêsh`esrêh shânâh hâyâh bhemolkho vachamishiym ushetayim shânâh mâlakhbiyrushâlâim veshêm 'immo yekhâlyâhu miyrushâlâim
vayya`ashayyâshâr be`êynêy Adonay kekhol 'asher-`âsâh 'amatsyâhu 'âbhiyv
raq habbâmoth lo'-sâru `odh hâ`âm mezabbechiym umeqatheriymbabbâmoth
vaynagga` Adonay 'eth-hammelekh vayhiy metsorâ``adh-yom motho vayyêshebh bebhêyth hachâphshiyth veyothâm ben-hammelekh.`al-habbayith shophêth 'eth-`am hâ'ârets
veyether dibhrêy `azaryâhuvekhol-'asher `âsâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiymlemalkhêy yehudhâh
vayyishkabh `azaryâh `im-'abhothâyv vayyiqberu'otho `im-'abhothâyv be`iyr dâvidh vayyimlokh yothâm beno tachtâyv ph

vayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonay ka'asher `âsu'abhothâyv lo' sâr mêchatho'vth yârâbh`âm ben-nebhâth 'asher hechethiy''eth-yisrâ'êl
vayyiqshor `âlâyv shallum ben-yâbhêsh vayyakkêhuqâbhâl`âm vaymiythêhu vayyimlokh tachtâyv
veyether dibhrêyzekharyâh hinnâm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêyyisrâ'êl
hu' dhebhar-Adonay 'asher dibber 'el-yêhu' lê'morbenêy rebhiy`iym yêshebhu lekha `al-kissê' yisrâ'êl vayhiy-khên ph
shallum ben-yâbhêysh mâlakh bishnath sheloshiym vâthêsha` shânâh le`uziyyâhmelekh yehudhâh vayyimlokh yerach-yâmiym beshomeron
vayya`almenachêm ben-gâdhiy mittirtsâh vayyâbho' shomeron vayyakh 'eth-shallumben-yâbhêysh beshomeron vaymiythêhu vayyimlokh tachtâyv
veyetherdibhrêy shallum veqishro 'asher qâshâr hinnâm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêyhayyâmiym lemalkhêy yisrâ'êl s

bâ' phul melekh-'ashur `al-hâ'ârets vayyittên menachêmlephul 'eleph kikkar-kâseph lihyoth yâdhâyv 'itto lehachaziyqhammamlâkhâh beyâdho
vayyotsê' menachêm 'eth-hakkeseph `al-yisrâ'êl `al kol-gibborêy hachayil lâthêth lemelekh 'ashur chamishiymsheqâliym keseph le'iysh 'echâdh vayyâshâbh melekh 'ashur velo'-`âmadhshâm bâ'ârets
veyether dibhrêy menachêm vekhol-'asher `âsâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yisrâ'êl
vayyishkabh menachêm `im-'abhothâyv vayyimlokh peqachyâh bheno.tachtâyv ph

vayyiqshor `âlâyv peqachben-remalyâhu shâliysho vayyakkêhu bheshomeron be'armon bêyth-melekh [ha][melekh] 'eth-'argobh ve'eth-hâ'aryêh ve`immo chamishiym'iysh mibbenêy ghil`âdhiym vaymiythêhu vayyimlokh tachtâyv
veyetherdibhrêy pheqachyâh vekhol-'asher `âsâh hinnâm kethubhiym `al-sêpherdibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yisrâ'êl ph

biymêy peqach melekh-yisrâ'êl bâ' tighlathpil'eser melekh 'ashur vayyiqqach 'eth-`iyyon ve'eth-'âbhêl bêyth-ma`akhâh ve'eth-yânoach ve'eth-qedhesh ve'eth-châtsor ve'eth-haggil`âdhve'eth-haggâliylâh kol 'erets naphtâliy vayyaghlêm 'ashurâh
vayyiqshâr-qesher hoshêa` ben-'êlâh `al-peqach ben-remalyâhuvayyakkêhu vaymiythêhu vayyimlokh tachtâyv bishnath `esriymleyothâm ben-`uziyyâh
veyether dibhrêy-pheqach vekhol-'asher `âsâhhinnâm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yisrâ'êlph
bishnath shetayim lepheqach ben-remalyâhu melekh yisrâ'êl mâlakhyothâm ben-`uziyyâhu melekh yehudhâh
ben-`esriym vechâmêshshânâh hâyâh bhemolkho veshêsh-`esrêh shânâh mâlakh biyrushâlâim veshêm'immo yerushâ' bath-tsâdhoq
vayya`as hayyâshâr be`êynêyAdonay kekhol 'asher-`âsâh `uziyyâhu 'âbhiyv `âsâh
raqhabbâmoth lo' sâru `odh hâ`âm mezabbechiym umeqatheriym babbâmothhu' bânâh 'eth-sha`ar bêyth-Adonay hâ`elyon

bayyâmiym hâhêm hêchêl Adonaylehashliyach biyhudhâh retsiyn melekh 'arâm ve'êth peqach ben-remalyâhu
vayyishkabh yothâm `im-'abhothâyv vayyiqqâbhêr `im-'abhothâyv be`iyrdâvidh 'âbhiyv vayyimlokh 'âchâz beno tachtâyv ph.
bishnath shebha`-`esrêh shânâh lepheqach ben-remalyâhumâlakh 'âchâz ben-yothâm melekh yehudhâh
ben-`esriym shânâh 'âchâzbemolkho veshêsh-`esrêh shânâh mâlakh biyrushâlâim velo'-`âsâhhayyâshâr be`êynêy Adonay 'elohâyv kedhâvidh 'âbhiyv
vayyêlekhbedherekh malkhêy yisrâ'êl vegham 'eth-beno he`ebhiyr bâ'êsh ketho`abhothhaggoyim 'asher horiysh Adonay 'othâm mippenêy benêy yisrâ'êl
vayzabbêach vayqathêr babbâmoth ve`al-haggebhâ`oth vethachath kol-`êtsra`anân
'âz ya`aleh retsiyn melekh-'arâm upheqach ben-remalyâhumelekh-yisrâ'êl yerushâlaim lammilchâmâh vayyâtsuru `al-'âchâz velo'yâkhlu lehillâchêm
bâ`êth hahiy' hêshiybh retsiyn melekh-'arâm 'eth-'êylathla'arâm vaynashêl 'eth-hayhudhiym mê'êyloth va'arammiym[va]['adhomiym] bâ'u 'êylath vayyêshebhu shâm `adh hayyom hazzeh ph

vayyishma` 'êlâyvmelekh 'ashur vayya`al melekh 'ashur 'el-dammeseq vayyithpesehâvayyaghlehâ qiyrâh ve'eth-retsiyn hêmiyth

vayyêlekh hammelekh'âchâz liqra'th tighlath pil'eser melekh-'ashur dummeseq vayyar' 'eth-hammizbêach 'asher bedhammâseq vayyishlach hammelekh 'âchâz'el-'uriyyâh hakkohên 'eth-demuth hammizbêach ve'eth-tabhniytho lekhol-ma`asêhu
vayyibhen 'uriyyâh hakkohên 'eth-hammizbêach kekhol'asher-shâlach hammelekh 'âchâz middammeseq kên `âsâh 'uriyyâhhakkohên `adh-bo' hammelekh-'âchâz middammâseq
vayyâbho'hammelekh middammeseq vayyar' hammelekh 'eth-hammizbêachvayyiqrabh hammelekh `al-hammizbêach vayya`al `âlâyv

ve'êth hammizbachhannechosheth 'asher liphnêy Adonay vayyaqrêbh mê'êth penêyhabbayith mibbêyn hammizbêach umibbêyn bêyth Adonay.vayyittên 'otho `al-yerekh hammizbêach tsâphonâh

vaytsavvêhu[va][yetsavveh] hammelekh-'âchâz 'eth-'uriyyâh hakkohên lê'mor `alhammizbêach haggâdhol haqthêr 'eth-`olath-habboqer ve'eth-minchathhâ`erebh ve'eth-`olath hammelekh ve'eth-minchâtho ve'êth `olath kol-`amhâ'ârets uminchâthâm veniskêyhem vekhol-dam `olâh vekhol-dam-zebhach `âlâyv tizroq umizbach hannechosheth yihyeh-liy lebhaqqêr

ve'eth-miysakh [musakh] hashabbâth 'asher-bânubhabbayith ve'eth-mebho' hammelekh hachiytsonâh hêsêbh bêyth Adonaymippenêy melekh 'ashur

vayyâbho' yesha`yâhu hannâbhiy' 'el-hammelekhchizqiyyâhu vayyo'mer 'êlâyv mâh 'âmru hâ'anâshiym hâ'êllehumê'ayin yâbho'u 'êleykha vayyo'mer chizqiyyâhu mê'erets rechoqâhbâ'u mibbâbhel
vayyo'mer mâh râ'u bebhêythekha vayyo'merchizqiyyâhu 'êth kol-'asher bebhêythiy râ'u lo'-hâyâh dhâbhâr 'asher lo'-hir'iythim be'otserothây
vayyo'mer yesha`yâhu 'el-chizqiyyâhu shema`debhar-Adonay
hinnêh yâmiym bâ'iym venisâ' kol-'asherbebhêythekha va'asher 'âtsru 'abhotheykha `adh-hayyom hazzeh bâbhelâhlo'-yivvâthêr dâbhâr 'âmar Adonay
umibbâneykha 'asher yêtse'umimmekha 'asher toliydh yiqqâch [yiqqâchu] vehâyu sâriysiym behêykhalmelekh bâbhel
vayyo'mer chizqiyyâhu 'el-yesha`yâhu thobh debhar-Adonay 'asher dibbartâ vayyo'mer halo' 'im-shâlom ve'emethyihyeh bheyâmây
veyether dibhrêy chizqiyyâhu vekhol-gebhurâthova'asher `âsâh 'eth-habberêkhâh ve'eth-hatte`âlâh vayyâbhê' 'eth-hammayim hâ`iyrâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêyhayyâmiym lemalkhêy yehudhâh
vayyishkabh chizqiyyâhu`im-'abhothâyv vayyimlokh menasheh bheno tachtâyv ph
ben-shetêym `esrêh shânâh menasheh bhemolkhovachamishiym vechâmêsh shânâh mâlakh biyrushâlâim veshêm 'immochephtsiy-bhâh
vayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonay ketho`abhothhaggoyim 'asher horiysh Adonay mippenêy benêy yisrâ'êl

vayyâshâbh vayyibhen 'eth-habbâmoth 'asher 'ibbadh chizqiyyâhu 'âbhiyvvayyâqem mizbechoth labba`al vayya`as 'ashêrâh ka'asher `âsâh 'ach'âbhmelekh yisrâ'êl vayyishtachu lekhol-tsebhâ' hashâmayim vayya`abhodh'othâm
ubhânâh mizbechoth bebhêyth Adonay 'asher 'âmar Adonaybiyrushâlaim 'âsiym 'eth-shemiy
vayyibhen mizbechoth lekhol-tsebhâ'.hashâmâyim bishtêy chatsroth bêyth-Adonay
vehe`ebhiyr 'eth-benobâ'êsh ve`onên venichêsh ve`âsâh 'obh veyidde`oniym hirbâh la`asothhâra` be`êynêy Adonay lehakh`iys

vayyâsem 'eth-peselhâ'ashêrâh 'asher `âsâh babbayith 'asher 'âmar Adonay 'el-dâvidhve'el-shelomoh bheno babbayith hazzeh ubhiyrushâlaim 'asher bâchartiymikkol shibhthêy yisrâ'êl 'âsiym 'eth-shemiy le`olâm
velo' 'osiyphlehâniydh reghel yisrâ'êl min-hâ'adhâmâh 'asher nâthattiy la'abhothâmraq 'im-yishmeru la`asoth kekhol 'asher tsivviythiym ulekhâl-hattorâh'asher-tsivvâh 'othâm `abhdiy mosheh
velo' shâmê`u vayyath`êmmenasheh la`asoth 'eth-hârâ` min-haggoyim 'asher hishmiydh Adonaymippenêy benêy yisrâ'êl
vaydhabbêr Adonay beyadh-`abhâdhâyvhannebhiy'iym lê'mor
ya`an 'asher `âsâh menasheh melekh-yehudhâhhatto`êbhoth hâ'êlleh hêra` mikkol 'asher-`âsu hâ'emoriy 'asherlephânâyv vayyachathi' gham-'eth-yehudhâh beghillulâyv ph
lâkhênkoh-'âmar Adonay 'elohêy yisrâ'êl hineniy mêbhiy' râ`âh `al-yerushâlaim viyhudhâh 'asher kol-shome`âyv [shome`âh] titsalnâh shetêy'âznâyv
venâthiythiy `al-yerushâlaim 'êth qâv shomeron ve'eth-mishqolethbêyth 'ach'âbh umâchiythiy 'eth-yerushâlaim ka'asher-yimcheh 'eth-hatsallachath mâchâh vehâphakh `al-pâneyhâ
venâthashtiy 'êth she'êriythnachalâthiy unethattiym beyadh 'oyebhêyhem vehâyu lebhaz velimshissâhlekhol-'oyebhêyhem
ya`an 'asher `âsu 'eth-hâra` be`êynay vayyihyumakh`isiym 'othiy min-hayyom 'asher yâts'u 'abhothâm mimmitsrayimve`adh hayyom hazzeh
vegham dâm nâqiy shâphakh menasheh harbêhme'odh `adh 'asher-millê' 'eth-yerushâlaim peh lâpheh lebhadh mêchathâ'tho'asher hechethiy' 'eth-yehudhâh la`asoth hâra` be`êynêy Adonay
veyether dibhrêy menasheh vekhol-'asher `âsâh vechathâ'tho 'asher châthâ'halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yehudhâh
vayyishkabh menasheh `im-'abhothâyv vayyiqqâbhêr beghan-bêythobeghan-`uzzâ' vayyimlokh 'âmon beno tachtâyv ph
ben-`esriymushetayim shânâh 'âmon bemolkho ushetayim shâniym mâlakhbiyrushâlâim veshêm 'immo meshullemeth bath-châruts min-yâthbhâh
vayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonay ka'asher `âsâh menasheh 'âbhiyv.
vayyêlekh bekhol-hadderekh 'asher-hâlakh 'âbhiyv vayya`abhodh 'eth-haggilluliym 'asher `âbhadh 'âbhiyv vayyishtachu lâhem
vayya`azobh'eth-Adonay 'elohêy 'abhothâyv velo' hâlakh bedherekh Adonay
vayyiqsheru `abhdhêy-'âmon `âlâyv vayyâmiythu 'eth-hammelekhbebhêytho
vayyakh `am-hâ'ârets 'êth kol-haqqosheriym `al-hammelekh'âmon vayyamliykhu `am-hâ'ârets 'eth-yo'shiyyâhu bheno tachtâyv
veyether dibhrêy 'âmon 'asher `âsâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpherdibhrêy hayyâmiym lemalkhêy yehudhâh
vayyiqbeor 'otho biqbhurâthobeghan-`uzzâ' vayyimlokh yo'shiyyâhu bheno tachtâyv ph
ben-shemoneh shânâh yo'shiyyâhu bhemolkho usheloshiymve'achath shânâh mâlakh biyrushâlâim veshêm 'immo yedhiydhâhbhath-`adhâyâh mibbotsqath
vayya`as hayyâshâr be`êynêy Adonayvayyêlekh bekhol-derekh dâvidh 'âbhiyv velo'-sâr yâmiyn usemo'vl ph
vayhiy bishmoneh `esrêh shânâh lammelekh yo'shiyyâhu shâlachhammelekh 'eth-shâphân ben-'atsalyâhu bhen-meshullâm hassophêr bêythAdonay lê'mor
`alêh 'el-chilqiyyâhu hakkohên haggâdholveyattêm 'eth-hakkeseph hammubhâ' bêyth Adonay 'asher 'âsphushomerêy hassaph mê'êth hâ`âm
veyittenoh [v][yittenuhu] `al-yadh`osêy hammelâ'khâh hammuphqâdhiym bebhêyth [bêyth] Adonayveyittenu 'otho le`osêy hammelâ'khâh 'asher bebhêyth Adonaylechazzêq bedheq habbâyith
lechârâshiym velabboniym velaggodheriymveliqnoth `êtsiym ve'abhnêy machtsêbh lechazzêq 'eth-habbâyith
'akh lo'-yêchâshêbh 'ittâm hakkeseph hannittân `al-yâdhâm kiy bhe'emunâh hêm`osiym
vayyo'mer chilqiyyâhu hakkohên haggâdhol `al-shâphânhassophêr sêpher hattorâh mâtsâ'thiy bebhêyth Adonay vayyittênchilqiyyâh 'eth-hassêpher 'el-shâphân vayyiqrâ'êhu

vayyâbho' shâphânhassophêr 'el-hammelekh vayyâshebh 'eth-hammelekh dâbhâr vayyo'merhittiykhu `abhâdheykha 'eth-hakkeseph hannimtsâ' bhabbayith vayyittenuhu`al-yadh `osêy hammelâ'khâh hammuphqâdhiym bêyth Adonay
vayyaggêdh shâphân hassophêr lammelekh lê'mor sêpher nâthan liychilqiyyâh hakkohên vayyiqrâ'êhu shâphân liphnêy hammelekh
vayhiy kishmoa` hammelekh 'eth-dibhrêy sêpher hattorâh vayyiqra`'eth-beghâdhâyv
vaytsav hammelekh 'eth-chilqiyyâh hakkohênve'eth-'achiyqâm ben-shâphân ve'eth-`akhbor ben-miykhâyâh ve'êth shâphânhassophêr ve'êth `asâyâh `ebhedh-hammelekh lê'mor

lekhu dhirshu 'eth-Adonay ba`adhiy ubhe`adh-hâ`âm ubhe`adh kol-yehudhâh `al-dibhrêyhassêpher hannimtsâ' hazzeh kiy-ghedholâh chamath Adonay 'asher-hiy' nitsethâh bhânu `al 'asher lo'-shâm`u 'abhothêynu `al-dibhrêy hassêpherhazzeh la`asoth kekhol-hakkâthubh `âlêynu

vayyêlekh chilqiyyâhuhakkohên va'achiyqâm ve`akhbor veshâphân va`asâyâh 'el-chuldâhhannebhiy'âh 'êsheth shallum ben-tiqvâh ben-charchas shomêrhabbeghâdhiym vehiy' yoshebheth biyrushâlaim bammishneh vaydhabberu'êleyhâ
vatto'mer 'alêyhem koh-'âmar Adonay 'elohêyyisrâ'êl 'imru lâ'iysh 'asher-shâlach 'ethkhem 'êlây
koh 'âmarAdonay hineniy mêbhiy' râ`âh 'el-hammâqom hazzeh ve`al-yoshebhâyv 'êth kol-dibhrêy hassêpher 'asher qârâ' melekh yehudhâh
tachath 'asher `azâbhuniy vayqatheru lê'lohiym 'achêriym lema`anhakh`iysêniy bekhol ma`asêh yedhêyhem venitsethâh chamâthiybammâqom hazzeh velo' thikhbeh
ve'el-melekh yehudhâh hasholêach'ethkhem lidhrosh 'eth-Adonay koh tho'mru 'êlâyv koh-'âmarAdonay 'elohêy yisrâ'êl haddebhâriym 'asher shâmâ`tâ

ya`anrakh-lebhâbhkha vattikkâna` mippenêy Adonay beshâm`akha 'asherdibbartiy `al-hammâqom hazzeh ve`al-yoshebhâyv lihyoth leshammâhveliqlâlâh vattiqra` 'eth-beghâdheykha vattibhkeh lephânây vegham 'ânokhiyshâma`tiy ne'um-Adonay
lâkhên hineniy 'osiphkha `al-'abhotheykhavene'esaphtâ 'el-qibhrotheykha beshâlom velo'-thir'eynâh `êyneykha bekholhârâ`âh 'asher-'aniy mêbhiy' `al-hammâqom hazzeh vayyâshiybhu'eth-hammelekh dâbhâr
vayyishlach hammelekh vayya'asphu 'êlâyv kol-ziqnêyyehudhâh viyrushâlâim

vayya`al hammelekh bêyth-Adonayvekhol-'iysh yehudhâh vekhol-yoshebhêy yerushâlaim 'itto vehakkohaniymvehannebhiy'iym vekhol-hâ`âm lemiqqâthon ve`adh-gâdhol vayyiqrâ'.bhe'âznêyhem 'eth-kâl-dibhrêy sêpher habberiyth hannimtsâ' bebhêythAdonay

vayya`amodh hammelekh `al-hâ`ammudh vayyikhroth'eth-habberiyth liphnêy Adonay lâlekheth 'achar Adonay velishmormitsvothâyv ve'eth-`êdhevothâyv ve'eth-chuqqothâyv bekhol-lêbh ubhekhâl-nephesh lehâqiym 'eth-dibhrêy habberiyth hazzo'th hakkethubhiym `al-hassêpher hazzeh vayya`amodh kol-hâ`âm babberiyth

vaytsavhammelekh 'eth-chilqiyyâhu hakkohên haggâdhol ve'eth-kohanêyhammishneh ve'eth-shomerêy hassaph lehotsiy' mêhêykhal Adonay'êth kol-hakkêliym hâ`asuyim labba`al velâ'ashêrâh ulekhol tsebhâ'hashâmâyim vayyisrephêm michuts liyrushâlaim beshadhmoth qidhronvenâsâ' 'eth-`aphârâm bêyth-'êl

vehishbiyth 'eth-hakkemâriym 'ashernâthnu malkhêy yehudhâh vayqathêr babbâmoth be`ârêy yehudhâhumesibbêy yerushâlâim ve'eth-hamqatheriym labba`al lashemeshvelayyârêach velammazzâloth ulekhol tsebhâ' hashâmâyim
vayyotsê''eth-hâ'ashêrâh mibbêyth Adonay michuts liyrushâlaim 'el-nachalqidhron vayyisroph 'othâh benachal qidhron vayyâdheq le`âphâr vayyashlêkh'eth-`aphârâh `al-qebher benêy hâ`âm
vayyittots 'eth-bâttêyhaqqedhêshiym 'asher bebhêyth Adonay 'asher hannâshiym 'oreghoth shâmbâttiym lâ'ashêrâh

vayyâbhê' 'eth-kâl-hakkohaniym mê`ârêyyehudhâh vaythammê' 'eth-habbâmoth 'asher qitheru-shâmmâhhakkohaniym miggebha` `adh-be'êr shâbha` venâthats 'eth-bâmothhashe`âriym 'asher-pethach sha`ar yehoshua` sar-hâ`iyr 'asher-`al-semo'vl'iysh besha`ar hâ`iyr
'akh lo' ya`alu kohanêy habbâmoth 'el-mizbachAdonay biyrushâlâim kiy 'im-'âkhlu matsoth bethokh 'achêyhem
vethimmê' 'eth-hattopheth 'asher beghêy bhenêy-hinnom [ghêy bhen-hinnom]lebhiltiy leha`abhiyr 'iysh 'eth-beno ve'eth-bitto bâ'êsh lammolekh
vayyashbêth 'eth-hassusiym 'asher nâthnu malkhêy yehudhâh lashemeshmibbo' bhêyth-Adonay 'el-lishkath nethan-melekh hassâriys 'asherbapparvâriym ve'eth-markebhoth hashemesh sâraph bâ'êsh

ve'eth-hammizbechoth 'asher `al-haggâgh `aliyyath 'âchâz 'asher-`âsu malkhêyyehudhâh ve'eth-hammizbechoth 'asher-`âsâh menasheh bishtêy chatsrothbêyth-Adonay nâthats hammelekh vayyârâts mishâm vehishliykh.'eth-`aphârâm 'el-nachal qidhron

ve'eth-habbâmoth 'asher `al-penêyyerushâlaim 'asher miymiyn lehar-hammashchiyth 'asher bânâh shelomohmelekh-yisrâ'êl le`ashtoreth shiqquts tsiydhoniym velikhmosh shiqquts mo'âbhulemilkom to`abhath benêy-`ammon thimmê' hammelekh
veshibbar'eth-hammatsêbhoth vayyikhroth 'eth-hâ'ashêriym vaymallê' 'eth-meqomâm `atsmoth 'âdhâm

vegham 'eth-hammizbêach 'asherbebhêyth-'êl habbâmâh 'asher `âsâh yârâbh`âm ben-nebhâth 'asher hechethiy''eth-yisrâ'êl gam 'eth-hammizbêach hahu' ve'eth-habbâmâh nâthâtsvayyisroph 'eth-habbâmâh hêdhaq le`âphâr vesâraph 'ashêrâh

vayyiphenyo'shiyyâhu vayyar' 'eth-haqqebhâriym 'asher-shâm bâhâr vayyishlachvayyiqqach 'eth-hâ`atsâmoth min-haqqebhâriym vayyisroph `al-hammizbêach vaythamme'êhu kidhbhar Adonay 'asher qârâ' 'iyshhâ'elohiym 'asher qârâ' 'eth-haddebhâriym hâ'êlleh

vayyo'mermâh hatsiyyun hallâz 'asher 'aniy ro'eh vayyo'mru 'êlâyv 'anshêyhâ`iyr haqqebher 'iysh-hâ'elohiym 'asher-bâ' miyhudhâh vayyiqrâ''eth-haddebhâriym hâ'êlleh 'asher `âsiythâ `al hammizbach bêyth-'êl
vayyo'mer hanniychu lo 'iysh 'al-yâna` `atsmothâyv vaymallethu`atsmothâyv 'êth `atsmoth hannâbhiy' 'asher-bâ' mishomeron
vegham'eth-kâl-bâttêy habbâmoth 'asher be`ârêy shomeron 'asher `âsu malkhêyyisrâ'êl lehakh`iys hêsiyr yo'shiyyâhu vayya`as lâhem kekhol-hamma`asiym 'asher `âsâh bebhêyth-'êl
vayyizbach 'eth-kâl-kohanêyhabbâmoth 'asher-shâm `al-hammizbechoth vayyisroph 'eth-`atsmoth 'âdhâm`alêyhem vayyâshâbh yerushâlâim
vaytsav hammelekh 'eth-kâl-hâ`âmlê'mor `asu phesach layhvh 'elohêykhem kakkâthubh `al sêpher habberiythhazzeh
kiy lo' na`asâh kappesach hazzeh miymêy hashophethiym'asher shâphthu 'eth-yisrâ'êl vekhol yemêy malkhêy yisrâ'êl umalkhêyyehudhâh
kiy 'im-bishmoneh `esrêh shânâh lammelekh yo'shiyyâhuna`asâh happesach hazzeh layhvh biyrushâlâim

vegham 'eth-hâ'obhothve'eth-hayyidde`oniym ve'eth-hatterâphiym ve'eth-haggilluliym ve'êthkol-hashiqqutsiym 'asher nir'u be'erets yehudhâh ubhiyrushâlaim bi`êryo'shiyyâhu lema`an hâqiym 'eth-dibhrêy hattorâh hakkethubhiym `al-hassêpher 'asher mâtsâ' chilqiyyâhu hakkohên bêyth Adonay
vekhâmohu lo'-hâyâh lephânâyv melekh 'asher-shâbh 'el-Adonaybekhol-lebhâbho ubhekhâl-naphsho ubhekhâl-me'odho kekhol torath moshehve'acharâyv lo'-qâm kâmohu
'akh lo'-shâbh Adonay mêcharon'appo haggâdhol 'asher-chârâh 'appo biyhudhâh `al kol-hakke`âsiym'asher hikh`iyso menasheh

vayyo'mer Adonay gam 'eth-yehudhâh'âsiyr mê`al pânay ka'asher hasirothiy 'eth-yisrâ'êl umâ'astiy 'eth-hâ`iyr hazzo'th 'asher-bâchartiy 'eth-yerushâlaim ve'eth-habbayith 'asher'âmartiy yihyeh shemiy shâm
veyether dibhrêy yo'shiyyâhuvekhol-'asher `âsâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiymlemalkhêy yehudhâh
beyâmâyv `âlâh phar`oh nekhoh melekh-mitsrayim `al-melekh 'ashur `al-nehar-perâth vayyêlekh hammelekhyo'shiyyâhu liqrâ'tho vaymiythêhu bimghiddo kir'otho 'otho

vayyarkibhuhu `abhâdhâyv mêth mimmeghiddo vaybhi'uhu yerushâlaimvayyiqberuhu biqbhurâtho vayyiqqach `am-hâ'ârets 'eth-yeho'âchâz ben-yo'shiyyâhu vayyimshechu 'otho vayyamliykhu 'otho tachath 'âbhiyv ph
ben-`esriym veshâlosh shânâh yeho'âchâz bemolkho usheloshâh chodhâshiymmâlakh biyrushâlâim veshêm 'immo chamuthal bath-yirmeyâhu millibhnâh
vayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonay kekhol 'asher-`âsu 'abhothâyv
vayya'asrêhu phar`oh nekhoh bheribhlâh be'erets chamâth bimlokh[mi][melokh] biyrushâlâim vayyitten-`onesh `al-hâ'ârets mê'âh khikkar-keseph vekhikkar zâhâbh
vayyamlêkh par`oh nekhoh 'eth-'elyâqiymben-yo'shiyyâhu tachath yo'shiyyâhu 'âbhiyv vayyassêbh 'eth-shemoyehoyâqiym ve'eth-yeho'âchâz lâqâch vayyâbho' mitsrayim vayyâmâthshâm

vehakkeseph vehazzâhâbh nâthan yehoyâqiym lephar`oh 'akhhe`eriykh 'eth-hâ'ârets lâthêth 'eth-hakkeseph `al-piy phar`oh 'iysh ke`erkonâghas 'eth-hakkeseph ve'eth-hazzâhâbh 'eth-`am hâ'ârets lâthêth lephar`ohnekhoh s
ben-`esriym vechâmêsh shânâh yehoyâqiym bemolkho ve'achath`esrêh shânâh mâlakh biyrushâlâim veshêm 'immo zebhiydhâh [zebhuddâh]bhath-pedhâyâh min-rumâh
vayya`as hâra` be`êynêy Adonaykekhol 'asher-`âsu 'abhothâyv
beyâmâyv `âlâh nebhukhadhne'tsar melekh bâbhel vayhiy-lo.yehoyâqiym `ebhedh shâlosh shâniym vayyâshâbh vayyimrâdh-bo

vayshallach Adonay bo 'eth-gedhudhêy khasdiym ve'eth-gedhudhêy 'arâmve'êth gedhudhêy mo'âbh ve'êth gedhudhêy bhenêy-`ammon vayshallechêmbiyhudhâh leha'abhiydho kidhbhar Adonay 'asher dibber beyadh`abhâdhâyv hannebhiy'iym
'akh `al-piy Adonay hâyethâh biyhudhâhlehâsiyr mê`al pânâyv bechatho'th menasheh kekhol 'asher `âsâh
veghamdam-hannâqiy 'asher shâphâkh vaymallê' 'eth-yerushâlaim dâm nâqiyvelo'-'âbhâh Adonay lisloach
veyether dibhrêy yehoyâqiymvekhol-'asher `âsâh halo'-hêm kethubhiym `al-sêpher dibhrêy hayyâmiymlemalkhêy yehudhâh

bê'dhayin qeriybhu ve'âmriyn qodhâm-malkâ' `al-'esâr malkâ' halâ''esâr reshamtâ diy khol-'enâsh diy-yibh`êh min-kâl-'elâh ve'enâsh `adh-yomiyn telâthiyn lâhên minnâkh malkâ' yithremê' leghobh 'aryâvthâ'`ânêh malkâ' ve'âmar yatsiybhâ' millethâ' kedhâth-mâdhay uphâras diy-lâ'the`dê'
bê'dhayin `ano ve'âmriyn qodhâm malkâ' diy dhâniyyê'ldiy min-benêy ghâluthâ' diy yehudh lâ'-sâm `alayikh [`alâkh] malkâ'the`êm ve`al-'esârâ' diy reshamtâ vezimniyn telâthâh beyomâ' bâ`ê'bâ`uthêh
'edhayin malkâ' kedhiy millethâ' shema` saggiy' be'êsh `alohiyve`al dâniyyê'l sâm bâl leshêyzâbhuthêh ve`adh me`âlêy shimshâ' havâ'mishtaddar lehatsâluthêh
bê'dhayin gubhrayyâ' 'illêkh hargishu `al-malkâ' ve'âmriyn lemalkâ' da` malkâ' diy-dhâth lemâdhay uphârasdiy-khâl-'esâr uqeyâm diy-malkâ' yehâqêym lâ' lehashnâyâh
bê'dhayin malkâ' 'amar vehaythiyv ledhâniyyê'l uremo leghubbâ' diy'aryâvâthâ' `ânêh malkâ' ve'âmar ledhâniyyê'l 'elâhâkh diy 'antâh['ant] pâlach-lêh bithdhiyrâ' hu' yeshêyzbhinnâkh
vehêythâyith 'ebhenchadhâh vesumath `al-pum gubbâ' vechathmah malkâ' be`izqethêhubhe`izqâth rabhrebhânohiy diy lâ'-thishnê' tsebhu bedhâniyyê'l
'edhayin'azal malkâ' lehêykhlêh ubhâth thevâth vedhachavân lâ'-han`êl qâdhâmohiyveshintêh naddath `alohiy
bê'dhayin malkâ' bishparpârâ' yequmbenoghhâ' ubhehithbehâlâh leghubbâ' dhiy-'aryâvâthâ' 'azal

ukhemiqrebhêh leghubbâ' ledhâniyyê'l beqâl `atsiybh ze`iq `ânêh malkâ've'âmar ledhâniyyê'l dâniyyê'l `abhêdh 'elâhâ' chayyâ' 'elâhâkh diy.'antâh ['ant] pâlach-lêh bithdhiyr haykhil leshêyzâbhuthâkh min-'aryâvâthâ'
'edhayin dâniyye'l `im-malkâ' mallil malkâ' le`âlmiyn cheyiy
'elâhiy shelach mal'akhêh usaghar pum 'aryâvâthâ' velâ' chabbeluniykol-qobhêl diy qâdhâmohiy zâkhu hishtekhachath liy ve'aph qâdhâmayikh[qâdhâmâkh] malkâ' chabhulâh lâ' `abhdhêth
bê'dhayin malkâ' saggiy'the'êbh `alohiy uledhâniyyê'l 'amar lehansâqâh min-gubbâ' vehussaqdâniyyê'l min-gubbâ' vekhol-chabhâl lâ'-hishtekhach bêh diy hêyminbê'lâhêh

va'amar malkâ' vehaythiyv gubhrayyâ' 'illêkh diy-'akhaluqartsohiy diy dhâniyyê'l uleghobh 'aryâvâthâ' remo 'innun benêyhonuneshêyhon velâ'-metho le'ar`iyth gubbâ' `adh diy-shelithu bhehon'aryâvâthâ' vekhol-garmêyhon haddiqu
bê'dhayin dâryâvesh malkâ'kethabh lekhol-`amemayyâ' 'umayyâ' velishânayyâ' diy-dhâ'ariyn[dhâyriyn] bekhol-'ar`â' shelâmkhon yisgê'

bishnath chadhâh lebhêle'shatsar melekh bâbhel dâniyyê'l chêlemchazâh vechezvêy rê'shêh `al-mishkebhêh bê'dhayin chelmâ' khethabh rê'shmilliyn 'amar
`ânêh dhâniyyê'l ve'âmar châzêh havêyth bechezviy`im-lêylyâ' va'aru 'arba` ruchêy shemayyâ' meghiychân leyammâ'rabbâ'
ve'arba` chêyvân rabhrebhân solqân min-yammâ' shânyândâ' min-dâ'
qadhmâythâ' khe'aryêh veghappiyn diy-neshar lah châzêhhavêyth `adh diy-meriythu ghappayh unethiylath min-'ar`â' ve`al-raghlayinke'enâsh hoqiymath ulebhabh 'enâsh yehiybh lah
va'aru chêyvâh 'ochoriythinyânâh dâmyâh ledhobh velisthar-chadh hoqimath uthelâth `il`iynbephummah bêyn shinnayyah [shinnah] vekhên 'âmriyn lah qumiy'akhuliy besar saggiy'
bâ'thar denâh châzêh havêyth va'aru 'ochoriy.kinmar velah gappiyn 'arba` diy-`oph `al-gabbayyah [gabbah]ve'arbe`âh rê'shiyn lechêyvthâ' veshâlthân yehiybh lah

bâ'thar denâhchâzêh havêyth bechezvêy lêylyâ' va'aru chêyvâh rebhiy`âyâh[rebhiy`â'âh] dechiylâh ve'êymthâniy vethaqqiyphâ' yattiyrâ' veshinnayindiy-pharzel lah rabhrebhân 'âkhlâh umaddeqâh ushe'ârâ' beraghlayyah[b][raghlah] râphsâh vehiy' meshanneyâh min-kâl-chêyvâthâ' diyqâdhâmayh veqarnayin `asar lah

mistakkal havêyth beqarnayyâ'va'alu qeren 'ochoriy ze`êyrâh silqâth bêynêyhon [bêynêyhên] uthelâthmin-qarnayyâ' qadhmâyâthâ' 'eth`aqaru ['eth`aqarâh] min-qodhâmayyah [qodhâmah] va'alu `ayniyn ke`aynêy 'anâshâ'beqarnâ'-dhâ' uphum memallil rabhrebhân
châzêh havêyth `adh diykhorsâvân remiyv ve`attiyq yomiyn yethibh lebhushêh kithlagh chivvâr use`arrê'shêh ka`amar neqê' korseyêh shebhiybhiyn diy-nur galgillohiy nurdâliq
nehar diy-nur nâghêdh venâphêq min-qodhâmohiy 'eleph'alphayim ['alphiyn] yeshammeshunnêh veribbo rabbevân [ribhebhân]qâdhâmohiy yequmun diynâ' yethibh vesiphriyn pethiychu
châzêh havêythbê'dhayin min-qâl millayyâ' rabhrebhâthâ' diy qarnâ' memallelâh châzêhhavêyth `adh diy qethiylath chêyvthâ' vehubhadh gishmah viyhiybhath liyqêdhath'eshâ'
ushe'âr chêyvâthâ' he`diyv shâlthânhon ve'arkhâh bhechayyiynyehiybhath lehon `adh-zeman ve`iddân
châzêh havêyth bechezvêylêylyâ' va'aru `im-`anânêy shemayyâ' kebhar 'enâsh 'âthêh havâhve`adh-`attiyq yomayyâ' methâh uqedhâmohiy haqrebhuhiy
velêhyehiybh shâlthân viyqâr umalkhu vekhol `amemayyâ' 'umayyâ'velishânayyâ' lêh yiphlechun shâlthânêh shâlthân `âlam diy-lâ' ye`dêhumalkhuthêh diy-lâ' thithchabbal ph

qirbhêth `al-chadhmin-qâ'amayyâ' veyatsiybhâ' 'ebh`ê'-minnêh `al-kâl-denâh va'amar-liy upheshar millayyâ' yehodhe`innaniy
'illêyn chêyvâthâ' rabhrebhâthâ'diy 'inniyn 'arba` 'arbe`âh malkhiyn yequmun min-'ar`â'

pôs oun elogisthê en peritomê onti ê en akrobustia ouk en peritomê all en akrobustia

kai sêmeion elaben peritomês sphragida tês dikaiosunês tês pisteôs tês en tê akrobustia eis to einai auton patera pantôn tôn pisteuontôn di akrobustias eis to logisthênai a=[kai] tsb=kai autois a=[tên] tsb=tên dikaiosunên
kai patera peritomês tois ouk ek peritomês monon alla kai tois stoichousin tois ichnesin tês b=pisteôs b=tês en tsb=tê akrobustia ats=pisteôs tou patros êmôn abraam
ou gar dia nomou ê epaggelia tô abraam ê tô spermati autou to klêronomon auton einai tsb=tou kosmou alla dia dikaiosunês pisteôs
ei gar oi ek nomou klêronomoi kekenôtai ê pistis kai katêrgêtai ê epaggelia
o gar nomos orgên katergazetai ou a=de tsb=gar ouk estin nomos oude parabasis
dia touto ek pisteôs ina kata charin eis to einai bebaian tên epaggelian panti tô spermati ou tô ek tou nomou monon alla kai tô ek pisteôs abraam os estin patêr pantôn êmôn
kathôs gegraptai oti patera pollôn ethnôn tetheika se katenanti ou episteusen theou tou zôopoiountos tous nekrous kai kalountos ta mê onta ôs onta
os par elpida ep elpidi episteusen eis to genesthai auton patera pollôn ethnôn kata to eirêmenon outôs estai to sperma sou
kai mê asthenêsas tê pistei tsb=ou katenoêsen to eautou sôma a=[êdê] tsb=êdê nenekrômenon ekatontaetês pou uparchôn kai tên nekrôsin tês mêtras sarras
eis de tên epaggelian
kai plêrophorêtheis oti o epêggeltai dunatos estin kai poiêsai
dio a=[kai] tsb=kai elogisthê autô eis dikaiosunên
ouk egraphê de di auton monon oti elogisthê autô
alla kai di êmas ois mellei logizesthai tois pisteuousin epi ton egeiranta iêsoun ton kurion êmôn ek nekrôn
os paredothê
dikaiôthentes oun ek pisteôs eirênên echomen pros ton theon dia tou kuriou êmôn iêsou christou
di ou kai tên prosagôgên eschêkamen a=[tê tsb=tê a=pistei] tsb=pistei eis tên charin tautên en ê estêkamen kai kauchômetha ep elpidi tês doxês tou theou
ou monon de alla kai kauchômetha en tais thlipsesin eidotes oti ê thlipsis upomonên katergazetai
ê de upomonê dokimên ê de dokimê elpida
ê de elpis ou kataischunei oti ê agapê tou theou ekkechutai en tais kardiais êmôn dia pneumatos agiou tou dothentos êmin
eti gar christos ontôn êmôn asthenôn a=eti kata kairon uper asebôn apethanen
molis gar uper dikaiou tis apothaneitai uper gar tou agathou tacha tis kai tolma apothanein
sunistêsin de tên eautou agapên eis êmas o theos oti eti amartôlôn ontôn êmôn christos uper êmôn apethanen
pollô oun mallon dikaiôthentes nun en tô aimati autou sôthêsometha di autou apo tês orgês
ei gar echthroi ontes katêllagêmen tô theô dia tou thanatou tou uiou autou pollô mallon katallagentes sôthêsometha en tê zôê autou
ou monon de alla kai kauchômenoi en tô theô dia tou kuriou êmôn iêsou christou di ou nun tên katallagên elabomen
dia touto ôsper di enos anthrôpou ê amartia eis ton kosmon eisêlthen kai dia tês amartias o thanatos kai outôs eis pantas anthrôpous o thanatos diêlthen eph ô pantes êmarton
achri gar nomou amartia ên en kosmô amartia de ouk ellogeitai mê ontos nomou
a=alla tsb=all ebasileusen o thanatos apo adam mechri a=môuseôs tsb=môseôs kai epi tous mê amartêsantas epi tô omoiômati tês parabaseôs adam os estin tupos tou mellontos

all ouch ôs to paraptôma outôs kai to charisma ei gar tô tou enos paraptômati oi polloi apethanon pollô mallon ê charis tou theou kai ê dôrea en chariti tê tou enos anthrôpou iêsou christou eis tous pollous eperisseusen
kai ouch ôs di enos amartêsantos to dôrêma to men gar krima ex enos eis katakrima to de charisma ek pollôn paraptômatôn eis dikaiôma
ei gar tô tou enos paraptômati o thanatos ebasileusen
ara oun ôs di enos paraptômatos eis pantas anthrôpous eis katakrima outôs kai di enos dikaiômatos eis pantas anthrôpous eis dikaiôsin zôês
ôsper gar dia tês parakoês tou enos anthrôpou amartôloi katestathêsan oi polloi outôs kai dia tês upakoês tou enos dikaioi katastathêsontai oi polloi
nomos de pareisêlthen ina pleonasê to paraptôma ou de epleonasen ê amartia upereperisseusen ê charis
ina ôsper ebasileusen ê amartia en tô thanatô outôs kai ê charis basileusê dia dikaiosunês eis zôên aiônion dia iêsou christou tou kuriou êmôn
ti oun eroumen a=epimenômen tsb=epimenoumen tê amartia ina ê charis pleonasê
mê genoito oitines apethanomen tê amartia pôs eti zêsomen en autê
ê agnoeite oti osoi ebaptisthêmen eis christon iêsoun eis ton thanaton autou ebaptisthêmen
sunetaphêmen oun autô dia tou baptismatos eis ton thanaton ina ôsper êgerthê christos ek nekrôn dia tês doxês tou patros outôs kai êmeis en kainotêti zôês peripatêsômen
ei gar sumphutoi gegonamen tô omoiômati tou thanatou autou alla kai tês anastaseôs esometha
touto ginôskontes oti o palaios êmôn anthrôpos sunestaurôthê ina katargêthê to sôma tês amartias tou mêketi douleuein êmas tê amartia
o gar apothanôn dedikaiôtai apo tês amartias
ei de apethanomen sun christô pisteuomen oti kai suzêsomen autô
eidotes oti christos egertheis ek nekrôn ouketi apothnêskei thanatos autou ouketi kurieuei
o gar apethanen tê amartia apethanen ephapax o de zê zê tô theô
outôs kai umeis logizesthe eautous a=[einai] nekrous men tsb=einai tê amartia zôntas de tô theô en christô iêsou tsb=tô tsb=kuriô tsb=êmôn
mê oun basileuetô ê amartia en tô thnêtô umôn sômati eis to upakouein tsb=autê tsb=en tais epithumiais autou
mêde paristanete ta melê umôn opla adikias tê amartia alla parastêsate eautous tô theô a=ôsei tsb=ôs ek nekrôn zôntas kai ta melê umôn opla dikaiosunês tô theô
amartia gar umôn ou kurieusei ou gar este upo nomon a=alla tsb=all upo charin
ti oun a=amartêsômen tsb=amartêsomen oti ouk esmen upo nomon a=alla tsb=all upo charin mê genoito
ouk oidate oti ô paristanete eautous doulous eis upakoên douloi este ô upakouete êtoi amartias eis thanaton ê upakoês eis dikaiosunên
charis de tô theô oti ête douloi tês amartias upêkousate de ek kardias eis on paredothête tupon didachês
eleutherôthentes de apo tês amartias edoulôthête tê dikaiosunê
anthrôpinon legô dia tên astheneian tês sarkos umôn ôsper gar parestêsate ta melê umôn doula tê akatharsia kai tê anomia eis tên anomian outôs
ote gar douloi ête tês amartias eleutheroi ête tê dikaiosunê
tina oun karpon eichete tote eph ois nun epaischunesthe to gar telos ekeinôn thanatos
nuni de eleutherôthentes apo tês amartias doulôthentes de tô theô echete ton karpon umôn eis agiasmon to de telos zôên aiônion
ta gar opsônia tês amartias thanatos to de charisma
ê agnoeite adelphoi ginôskousin gar nomon lalô oti o nomos kurieuei tou anthrôpou eph oson chronon zê
ê gar upandros gunê tô zônti andri dedetai nomô ean de apothanê o anêr katêrgêtai apo tou nomou tou andros
ara oun zôntos tou andros moichalis chrêmatisei ean genêtai andri eterô ean de apothanê o anêr eleuthera estin apo tou nomou tou mê einai autên moichalida genomenên andri eterô
ôste adelphoi mou kai umeis ethanatôthête tô nomô
ote gar êmen en tê sarki ta pathêmata tôn amartiôn ta dia tou nomou enêrgeito en tois melesin êmôn eis to karpophorêsai tô thanatô
nuni de katêrgêthêmen apo tou nomou s=apothanontos abt=apothanontes en ô kateichometha ôste douleuein êmas en kainotêti pneumatos kai ou palaiotêti grammatos
ti oun eroumen o nomos amartia mê genoito alla tên amartian ouk egnôn ei mê dia nomou tên te gar epithumian ouk êdein ei mê o nomos elegen ouk epithumêseis
aphormên de labousa ê amartia dia tês entolês kateirgasato en emoi pasan epithumian chôris gar nomou amartia nekra
egô de ezôn chôris nomou pote elthousês de tês entolês ê amartia anezêsen egô de apethanon
kai eurethê moi ê entolê ê eis zôên autê eis thanaton
ê gar amartia aphormên labousa
ôste o men nomos agios kai ê entolê agia kai dikaia kai agathê

to oun agathon emoi a=egeneto tsb=gegonen thanatos mê genoito alla ê amartia ina phanê amartia dia tou agathou moi katergazomenê thanaton ina genêtai kath uperbolên amartôlos ê amartia dia tês entolês
oidamen gar oti o nomos pneumatikos estin egô de a=sarkinos tsb=sarkikos eimi pepramenos upo tên amartian
o gar katergazomai ou ginôskô ou gar o thelô touto prassô all o misô touto poiô
ei de o ou thelô touto poiô sumphêmi tô nomô oti kalos
nuni de ouketi egô katergazomai auto a=alla tsb=all ê oikousa en emoi amartia
oida gar oti ouk oikei en emoi ab=tout ab=estin ts=toutestin en tê sarki mou agathon to gar thelein parakeitai moi to de katergazesthai to kalon a=ou tsb=ouch tsb=euriskô
ou gar o thelô poiô agathon a=alla tsb=all o ou thelô kakon touto prassô
ei de o ou thelô a=[egô] tsb=egô touto poiô ouketi egô katergazomai auto a=alla tsb=all ê oikousa en emoi amartia
euriskô ara ton nomon tô thelonti emoi poiein to kalon oti emoi to kakon parakeitai
sunêdomai gar tô nomô
blepô de eteron nomon en tois melesin mou antistrateuomenon tô nomô tou noos mou kai aichmalôtizonta me ab=en tô nomô tês amartias tô onti en tois melesin mou
talaipôros egô anthrôpos tis me rusetai ek tou sômatos tou thanatou toutou
a=charis a=de tsb=eucharistô tô theô dia iêsou christou tou kuriou êmôn ara oun autos egô tô men noi douleuô nomô theou tê de sarki nomô amartias
ouden ara nun katakrima tois en christô iêsou tsb=mê tsb=kata tsb=sarka tsb=peripatousin tsb=alla tsb=kata tsb=pneuma
o gar nomos tou pneumatos tês zôês en christô iêsou êleutherôsen a=se tsb=me apo tou nomou tês amartias kai tou thanatou
to gar adunaton tou nomou en ô êsthenei dia tês sarkos o theos ton eautou uion pempsas en omoiômati sarkos amartias kai peri amartias katekrinen tên amartian en tê sarki
ina to dikaiôma tou nomou plêrôthê en êmin tois mê kata sarka peripatousin alla kata pneuma
oi gar kata sarka ontes ta tês sarkos phronousin oi de kata pneuma ta tou pneumatos
to gar phronêma tês sarkos thanatos to de phronêma tou pneumatos zôê kai eirênê
dioti to phronêma tês sarkos echthra eis theon tô gar nomô tou theou ouch upotassetai oude gar dunatai
oi de en sarki ontes theô aresai ou dunantai
umeis de ouk este en sarki a=alla tsb=all en pneumati eiper pneuma theou oikei en umin ei de tis pneuma christou ouk echei outos ouk estin autou
ei de christos en umin to men sôma nekron ab=dia ts=di amartian to de pneuma zôê dia dikaiosunên

ei de to pneuma tou egeirantos a=ton iêsoun ek nekrôn oikei en umin o egeiras tsb=ton christon ek nekrôn zôopoiêsei kai ta thnêta sômata umôn dia as=tou bt=to as=enoikountos bt=enoikoun autou as=pneumatos bt=pneuma en umin
ara oun adelphoi opheiletai esmen ou tê sarki tou kata sarka zên
ei gar kata sarka zête mellete apothnêskein ei de pneumati tas praxeis tou sômatos thanatoute zêsesthe
osoi gar pneumati theou agontai outoi tsb=eisin uioi theou a=eisin
ou gar elabete pneuma douleias palin eis phobon a=alla tsb=all elabete pneuma uiothesias en ô krazomen abba o patêr
auto to pneuma summarturei tô pneumati êmôn oti esmen tekna theou
ei de tekna kai klêronomoi klêronomoi men theou sugklêronomoi de christou eiper sumpaschomen ina kai sundoxasthômen
logizomai gar oti ouk axia ta pathêmata
ê gar apokaradokia tês ktiseôs tên apokalupsin tôn uiôn tou theou apekdechetai
tê gar mataiotêti ê ktisis upetagê ouch ekousa alla
oti kai autê ê ktisis eleutherôthêsetai apo tês douleias tês phthoras eis tên eleutherian tês doxês tôn teknôn tou theou
oidamen gar oti pasa ê ktisis sustenazei kai sunôdinei achri tou nun
ou monon de alla kai autoi tên aparchên tou pneumatos echontes tsb=kai êmeis a=kai autoi en eautois stenazomen uiothesian apekdechomenoi tên apolutrôsin tou sômatos êmôn
tê gar elpidi esôthêmen elpis de blepomenê ouk estin elpis o gar blepei tis tsb=ti tsb=kai elpizei
ei de o ou blepomen elpizomen di upomonês apekdechometha

ôsautôs de kai to pneuma sunantilambanetai a=tê tsb=tais a=astheneia tsb=astheneiais êmôn to gar ti b=proseuxometha ats=proseuxômetha katho dei ouk oidamen a=alla tsb=all auto to pneuma uperentugchanei tsb=uper tsb=êmôn stenagmois alalêtois
o de a=eraunôn tsb=ereunôn tas kardias oiden ti to phronêma tou pneumatos oti kata theon entugchanei uper agiôn
oidamen de oti tois agapôsin ton theon panta sunergei eis agathon tois kata prothesin klêtois ousin
oti ous proegnô kai proôrisen summorphous tês eikonos tou uiou autou eis to einai auton prôtotokon en pollois adelphois
ous de proôrisen toutous kai ekalesen kai ous ekalesen toutous kai edikaiôsen ous de edikaiôsen toutous kai edoxasen
ti oun eroumen pros tauta ei o theos uper êmôn tis kath êmôn
os ge tou idiou uiou ouk epheisato a=alla tsb=all uper êmôn pantôn paredôken auton pôs ouchi kai sun autô ta panta êmin charisetai
tis egkalesei kata eklektôn theou theos o dikaiôn
tis o katakrinôn christos a=[iêsous] o apothanôn mallon de tsb=kai egertheis os kai estin en dexia tou theou os kai entugchanei uper êmôn
tis êmas chôrisei apo tês agapês
kathôs gegraptai oti ab=eneken ts=eneka sou thanatoumetha olên tên êmeran elogisthêmen ôs probata sphagês
all en toutois pasin upernikômen
pepeismai gar oti oute thanatos oute zôê oute aggeloi oute archai oute tsb=dunameis tsb=oute enestôta oute mellonta a=oute a=dunameis
oute upsôma oute bathos oute tis ktisis etera dunêsetai êmas chôrisai apo tês agapês tou theou tês en christô iêsou tô kuriô êmôn
alêtheian legô en christô ou pseudomai summarturousês moi tês suneidêseôs mou en pneumati agiô
oti lupê moi estin megalê kai adialeiptos odunê tê kardia mou
b=euchomên ats=êuchomên gar tsb=autos tsb=egô anathema einai a=autos a=egô apo tou christou uper tôn adelphôn mou tôn suggenôn mou kata sarka
oitines eisin israêlitai ôn ê uiothesia kai ê doxa kai
ôn oi pateres kai ex ôn o christos to kata sarka o ôn epi pantôn theos eulogêtos eis tous aiônas amên
ouch oion de oti ekpeptôken o
oud oti eisin sperma abraam pantes tekna all en isaak klêthêsetai soi sperma
ab=tout ab=estin ts=toutestin ou ta tekna tês sarkos tauta tekna tou theou alla ta tekna tês epaggelias logizetai eis sperma
epaggelias gar o logos outos kata ton kairon touton eleusomai kai estai tê sarra uios
ou monon de alla kai rebekka ex enos koitên echousa isaak tou patros êmôn
mêpô gar gennêthentôn mêde praxantôn ti agathon ê a=phaulon tsb=kakon ina ê kat eklogên ab=prothesis tou theou ts=prothesis menê ouk ex ergôn all ek tou kalountos
a=errethê tsb=errêthê autê oti o meizôn douleusei tô elassoni
kathôs gegraptai ton iakôb êgapêsa ton de êsau emisêsa
ti oun eroumen mê adikia para tô theô mê genoito
tô a=môusê gar b=môusê ts=môsê legei eleêsô on an eleô kai a=oiktirêsô tsb=oikteirêsô on an a=oiktirô tsb=oikteirô
ara oun ou tou thelontos oude tou trechontos alla tou a=eleôntos tsb=eleountos theou
legei gar ê graphê tô pharaô oti eis auto touto exêgeira se opôs endeixômai en soi tên dunamin mou kai opôs diaggelê to onoma mou en pasê tê gê
ara oun on thelei eleei on de thelei sklêrunei
ereis tsb=oun moi a=oun ti a=[oun] eti memphetai tô gar boulêmati autou tis anthestêken
tsb=menounge ô anthrôpe a=menounge su tis ei o antapokrinomenos tô theô mê erei to plasma tô plasanti ti me epoiêsas outôs
ê ouk echei exousian o kerameus tou pêlou ek tou autou phuramatos poiêsai o men eis timên skeuos o de eis atimian
ei de thelôn o theos endeixasthai tên orgên kai gnôrisai to dunaton autou ênegken en pollê makrothumia skeuê orgês katêrtismena eis apôleian
kai ina gnôrisê ton plouton tês doxês autou epi skeuê eleous a proêtoimasen eis doxan
ous kai ekalesen êmas ou monon ex ioudaiôn alla kai ex ethnôn
ôs kai en tô ôsêe legei kalesô ton ou laon mou laon mou kai tên ouk êgapêmenên êgapêmenên
kai estai en tô topô ou a=errethê tsb=errêthê autois ou laos mou umeis ekei klêthêsontai uioi theou zôntos
êsaias de krazei uper
logon gar suntelôn kai suntemnôn tsb=en tsb=dikaiosunê tsb=oti tsb=logon tsb=suntetmêmenon poiêsei kurios epi tês gês
kai kathôs proeirêken êsaias ei mê kurios sabaôth egkatelipen êmin sperma ôs sodoma an egenêthêmen kai ôs
ti oun eroumen oti ethnê ta mê diôkonta dikaiosunên katelaben dikaiosunên dikaiosunên de tên ek pisteôs
israêl de diôkôn nomon dikaiosunês eis nomon tsb=dikaiosunês ouk ephthasen
ab=dia ab=ti ts=diati oti ouk ek pisteôs all ôs ex ergôn tsb=nomou prosekopsan tsb=gar tô lithô tou proskommatos
kathôs gegraptai idou tithêmi en siôn lithon proskommatos kai petran skandalou kai tsb=pas o pisteuôn ep autô ou kataischunthêsetai
adelphoi ê men eudokia tês emês kardias kai ê deêsis tsb=ê pros ton theon uper a=autôn tsb=tou tsb=israêl tsb=estin eis sôtêrian
marturô gar autois oti zêlon theou echousin all ou kat epignôsin
agnoountes gar tên tou theou dikaiosunên kai tên idian a=[dikaiosunên] tsb=dikaiosunên zêtountes stêsai tê dikaiosunê tou theou ouch upetagêsan
telos gar nomou christos eis dikaiosunên panti tô pisteuonti
ab=môusês ts=môsês gar graphei tên dikaiosunên tên ek a=[tou] tsb=tou nomou oti o poiêsas auta anthrôpos zêsetai en autois
ê de ek pisteôs dikaiosunê outôs legei mê eipês en tê kardia sou tis anabêsetai eis ton ouranon tout estin christon katagagein
ê tis katabêsetai eis tên abusson tout estin christon ek nekrôn anagagein
alla ti legei eggus sou to rêma estin en tô stomati sou kai en tê kardia sou tout estin to rêma tês pisteôs o kêrussomen
oti ean omologêsês en tô stomati sou kurion iêsoun kai pisteusês en tê kardia sou oti o theos auton êgeiren ek nekrôn sôthêsê
kardia gar pisteuetai eis dikaiosunên stomati de omologeitai eis sôtêrian
legei gar ê graphê pas o pisteuôn ep autô ou kataischunthêsetai
ou gar estin diastolê ioudaiou te kai ellênos o gar autos kurios pantôn ploutôn eis pantas tous epikaloumenous auton
pas gar os an epikalesêtai to onoma kuriou sôthêsetai
pôs oun a=epikalesôntai tsb=epikalesontai eis on ouk episteusan pôs de a=pisteusôsin tsb=pisteusousin ou ouk êkousan pôs de a=akousôsin tsb=akousousin chôris kêrussontos
pôs de a=kêruxôsin tsb=kêruxousin ean mê apostalôsin kathôs gegraptai ôs ôraioi oi podes tôn euaggelizomenôn a=[ta] tsb=eirênên tsb=tôn tsb=euaggelizomenôn tsb=ta agatha
all ou pantes upêkousan tô euaggeliô êsaias gar legei kurie tis episteusen tê akoê êmôn
ara ê pistis ex akoês ê de akoê
alla legô mê ouk êkousan menounge eis pasan tên gên exêlthen o phthoggos autôn kai eis ta perata tês oikoumenês ta rêmata autôn
alla legô mê tsb=ouk tsb=egnô israêl a=ouk a=egnô prôtos ab=môusês ts=môsês legei egô parazêlôsô umas ep ouk ethnei a=ep tsb=epi ethnei asunetô parorgiô umas
êsaias de apotolma kai legei eurethên a=[en] tois eme mê zêtousin emphanês egenomên tois eme mê eperôtôsin
